description: This file contains the implementation of serialization, surrogate conversion, and deep copying for ReadOnlyDictionary types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines codecs, surrogates, and copiers to handle ReadOnlyDictionary objects during serialization and deep copy operations.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Codec for serializing and deserializing ReadOnlyDictionary objects using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate struct for ReadOnlyDictionary used during serialization.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier implementation for ReadOnlyDictionary to support deep cloning.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a ReadOnlyDictionary.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlyDictionary into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a ReadOnlyDictionary, handling cyclic references and type checks.
